record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210> of David<WH01732>.<Fo><Fo> Give<WH03051><WTH8798> unto the LORD<WH03068>, O ye mighty<WH01121><WH0410>, give<WH03051><WTH8798> unto the LORD<WH03068> glory<WH03519> and strength<WH05797>. <RF>ye mighty: Heb. ye sons of the mighty<Rf>

Give<WH03051><WTH8798> unto the LORD<WH03068> the glory<WH03519> due unto his name<WH08034>; worship<WH07812><WTH8690> the LORD<WH03068> in the beauty<WH01927> of holiness<WH06944>. <RF>the glory...: Heb. the honour of his name<Rf> <RF>in...: or, in his glorious sanctuary<Rf>

The voice<WH06963> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> upon the waters<WH04325>: the God<WH0410> of glory<WH03519> thundereth<WH07481><WTH8689>: the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> upon many<WH07227> waters<WH04325>. <RF>many: or, great<Rf>

The voice<WH06963> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> powerful<WH03581>; the voice<WH06963> of the LORD<WH03068> <FI>is<Fi> full of majesty<WH01926>. <RF>powerful: Heb. in power<Rf> <RF>full...: Heb. in majesty<Rf>
The voice<WH06963> of the LORD<WH03068> breaketh<WH07665><WTH8799> the cedars<WH0730>; yea, the LORD<WH03068> breaketh<WH07665><WTH8762> the cedars<WH0730> of Lebanon<WH03844>.
He maketh them also to skip<WH07540><WTH8686> like a calf<WH05695>; Lebanon<WH03844> and Sirion<WH08303> like a young<WH01121> unicorn<WH07214>.
The voice<WH06963> of the LORD<WH03068> divideth<WH02672><WTH8802> the flames<WH03852> of fire<WH0784>. <RF>divideth: Heb. cutteth out<Rf>
The voice<WH06963> of the LORD<WH03068> shaketh<WH02342><WTH8799> the wilderness<WH04057>; the LORD<WH03068> shaketh<WH02342><WTH8799> the wilderness<WH04057> of Kadesh<WH06946>.

The voice<WH06963> of the LORD<WH03068> maketh the hinds<WH0355> to calve<WH02342><WTH8787>, and discovereth<WH02834><WTH8799> the forests<WH03295>: and in his temple<WH01964> doth every one speak<WH0559><WTH8802> of <FI>his<Fi> glory<WH03519>. <RF>to calve: or, to be in pain<Rf> <RF>doth...: or, every whit of it uttereth, etc<Rf>
The LORD<WH03068> sitteth<WH03427><WTH8804> upon the flood<WH03999>; yea, the LORD<WH03068> sitteth<WH03427><WTH8799> King<WH04428> for ever<WH05769>.
The LORD<WH03068> will give<WH05414><WTH8799> strength<WH05797> unto his people<WH05971>; the LORD<WH03068> will bless<WH01288><WTH8762> his people<WH05971> with peace<WH07965>.<CM>
